primary_locator: https://link.springer.com/content/pdf/10.1007/s00115-023-01473-9.pdf | DGN One news PDF p 4 and DBS reference 12 PDF p 12
assessment: Apple identifies an app store carrying the German Neurological Society's DGN One app. Dystonia occurs in a separately cited study of deep brain stimulation sites for cervical and generalized dystonia. The Society news has no dietary comparison.

primary_locator: https://link.springer.com/content/pdf/10.1007/s11606-023-08226-z.pdf | pp S378 and S388, SGIM controls 3867696 and 3871920
assessment: Control 3867696 reports applesauce and gelatin as part of the history of poor oral intake in a patient with severe hypokalemia. Control 3871920 is a separate acute dystonia case after prochlorperazine. Apple Siri and Apple Watch hits elsewhere refer to technology.

primary_locator: https://link.springer.com/content/pdf/10.1007/BF03405813.pdf | IUPS 2009 P4PM-21-11 and P5AM-11-7, PDF pp 56 and 81
assessment: P4PM-21-11 studies isolated phloretin, found in apples and other fruit, against hepatocellular cancer cells and xenografts. P5AM-11-7 separately studies pallidal neuronal activity in a DYT1 mouse model. The proceedings do not link baked-apple intake to dystonia severity.

primary_locator: https://link.springer.com/content/pdf/10.1007/s11606-024-08797-5.pdf | pp S175 and S396, SGIM control 4064253
assessment: Apple Watch appears in a wide-complex tachycardia vignette concerning detection of arrhythmias. Control 4064253 separately reports focal dystonia during toxoplasmic encephalitis in a patient with HIV, without a dietary contrast.
